description: This Java source file defines the SurveyHelper class, which provides utility methods for creating, retrieving, updating, activating, deactivating, and managing surveys within the Apache Fineract project. It interacts with the Fineract API via retrofit2 calls and manages survey data structures, questions, and responses.

classes.name: SurveyHelper
classes.description: Helper class to manage survey operations such as creation, retrieval, update, activation, and deactivation within the Fineract system.

methods.name: createSurvey
methods.description: Creates a new survey with specified name, description, validity period, and questions.

methods.name: retrieveSurvey
methods.description: Retrieves a survey by its unique ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllSurveys
methods.description: Fetches all surveys available in the system.

methods.name: updateSurvey
methods.description: Updates an existing survey with new data.

methods.name: deactivateSurvey
methods.description: Deactivates a survey by its ID.

methods.name: activateSurvey
methods.description: Activates a survey by its ID.

methods.name: getSurveyName
methods.description: Returns the name of a survey.

methods.name: getSurveyDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of a survey.

methods.name: getSurveyValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the start date for survey validity.

methods.name: getSurveyValidTo
methods.description: Returns the end date for survey validity.

methods.name: getSurveyQuestionsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of questions in the survey.

methods.name: getSurveyKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with the survey.

methods.name: getSurveyCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the country code associated with the survey.
